events.title: Item 5.02 — 控股股东减持计划
Item 8.01 — 股票回购与毛利率展望
Item 2.02 — 净息差与拨备更新

files.text: Zenith Arc Robotics today announced that its largest shareholder will sell 4.5 million shares, or 4.5% of outstanding stock, over the next six months. The company said the sale reflects portfolio rebalancing and that the shareholder will retain a 12% stake. Separately, management reaffirmed its full-year revenue guidance.

Zephyr Foods announced a $150 million share repurchase program and raised its gross margin outlook to 31%. The company said input costs have stabilized and that it expects the buyback to be funded from operating cash flow.

Zhongzhi Cloud reported third-quarter revenue growth of 12%, down from 28% a year earlier. Management attributed the slowdown to the timing of two large contracts and said the pipeline remains healthy. The company kept its full-year outlook unchanged.
Zinc Bay Bancorp reported stable net interest margin and a provision coverage ratio of 180%. Management said credit costs remained contained and that deposit balances were stable during the quarter.
Zeta Energy Partners said it is reviewing its capital allocation plan after commodity prices fell. The company did not provide updated guidance and said the review may take several weeks.
Zenmed Diagnostics appointed a new chief financial officer effective next month. The company said the appointment follows a planned transition and does not change its financial reporting calendar.
